$comment: Moonrush on BNB Chain (BSC mainnet). The network moonrush-cli and the Moonrush app trade on when --networkId is 56, bnb or bsc. Values match what the Moonrush backend uses in production; src/lib/validate.test.ts fails if the CLI and this file disagree.

features: discovery boards: Trending, Movers, New and Verified for BNB Chain tokens
token lookup and risk report for BEP-20 tokens
market buys and sells of BEP-20 tokens, routed through Relay into the user's own BNB Chain wallet
limit, take-profit, stop-loss and trailing orders on BNB Chain positions
USDC cash-out bridged to a BNB Chain address
AI trading agents that buy and sell BNB Chain tokens

swapRouting.note: Buys swap the user's USDC into the BEP-20 token, delivered to the user's own wallet on BNB Chain; sells swap it back to USDC

cashOutStable.note: Binance-Peg USD Coin has 18 decimals on BNB Chain, not 6 as on other chains
